targetText: WE are living in an age of great social transformations that are steadily progressing.
summary: Bebel introduces the woman question as an inseparable component of the general social question.
explanation: Bebel introduces the woman question as an inseparable component of the general social question. He shows that millions of women are either excluded from marriage and motherhood by economic conditions or trapped in marital servitude and super-exploited wage labor. True female emancipation requires complete economic independence and the socialist reorganization of society.
